description: This file defines a utility class for Base64 encoding and decoding. It provides methods to decode Base64 data into raw bytes and handles Base64 character mappings.

classes.name: Base64
classes.description: A utility class for encoding and decoding Base64 data.

methods.name: decodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded byte array into raw bytes.

methods.name: discardNonBase64
methods.description: Removes non-Base64 characters from the input data.
